**Overview**
 Radancy is the global leader in talent acquisition software, helping employers attract and hire the right talent through AI\-powered recruiting technology, data\-driven insights, and world\-class candidate experiences. Our platform enables organizations to streamline hiring, strengthen employer branding, and drive measurable recruitment outcomes at scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Radancy is looking for a Vulnerability Management Engineer to strengthen vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation across our global SaaS product and corporate IT environments.
   

  

 Based in our Bengaluru office, you will work with infrastructure, security, and engineering teams to ensure vulnerabilities are identified, routed to the correct owners, remediated appropriately, and validated through closure. You will also coordinate with external penetration\-testing providers and technical service partners when their work contributes to vulnerability identification or remediation.
   

  

 This role combines vulnerability platform engineering, operational vulnerability management, and process automation. You will help integrate tools and workflows across application, cloud, infrastructure, and external\-facing environments while creating repeatable processes that reduce manual effort and improve visibility.
   

  

**What does a great Vulnerability Management Engineer do?**
* Administer and improve vulnerability\-management tools and integrations across application, cloud, infrastructure, network, and external\-facing environments.
* Configure and maintain scanning coverage, schedules, asset inventories, authenticated scanning, integrations, and related workflows.
* Create scalable and automated processes to route findings to the correct teams, track remediation, support risk and exception workflows, and validate closure.
* Integrate vulnerability data with ticketing, reporting, cloud, and security platforms, including tools such as Burp Suite, Akamai, and applicable AWS and Azure services.
* Monitor externally exposed assets and public\-facing applications for vulnerabilities, coverage gaps, and changes in exposure.
* Partner with infrastructure, security, and engineering teams to investigate findings, clarify risk, support remediation, and reduce recurring vulnerabilities.
* Coordinate vulnerability\-related activities and findings from external penetration tests, security assessments, and technical service partners.
* Prioritize findings using exploitability, asset criticality, exposure, threat intelligence, and business context rather than severity scores alone.
* Monitor vulnerability and asset coverage, resolve scanning or integration gaps, and maintain metrics on exposure, remediation performance, exceptions, recurring issues, and overall program health.


**Qualifications**
* 4 or more years of experience in vulnerability management, security engineering, application security operations, cloud security, or a related technical security role.
* Hands\-on experience administering vulnerability\-assessment or application\-security tools such as Burp Suite Enterprise, Qualys, InsightVM, Veracode, or comparable platforms.
* Experience managing the vulnerability lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through remediation, validation, exception handling, and closure.
* Experience integrating security tools with ticketing systems, APIs, cloud platforms, or other operational workflows.
* Working knowledge of vulnerabilities affecting cloud infrastructure, operating systems, networks, web applications, and common enterprise technologies.
* Understanding of CVSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, and risk\-based vulnerability prioritization.
* Familiarity with AWS environments and cloud vulnerability findings affecting services such as EC2, containers, networking, identity, and managed services.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, analytical, automation, and cross\-functional communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Burp Suite Enterprise and Akamai security products.
* Experience supporting external penetration tests and incorporating findings into vulnerability\-management workflows.
* Experience with AWS\-native vulnerability and security services, container or Kubernetes environments, and cloud asset inventories.
* Experience using scripting, APIs, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar tools to automate vulnerability\-management workflows.
* Familiarity with OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, secure development practices, and compliance requirements related to vulnerability management.
* Experience working with distributed global engineering teams and external technical service providers.


**Company Values:**

* Innovative Spirit Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what’s new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we’re shaping the future and leading the industry forward.
* Rewarding Impact Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people’s lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose.
* Performance Driven Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support.
* Supportive Teams Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry\-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.


*Radancy is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. * Define governance processes across the AI product lifecycle, from ideation and development to deployment, versioning, deprecation, and consumption.
* Promote architectural patterns and interoperability standards that enable cross\-domain consumption and scaling of AI capabilities.


**Governance \& Compliance (Accountability: Trust, Security \& Responsible AI)**
* Partner with governance teams to embed policies, quality standards, security controls, and compliance requirements directly into the AI platform and product development processes.
* Ensure the platform supports full auditability, lineage, and transparency for all AI products, supporting both regulatory readiness and responsible AI principles.
* Implement and enforce robust security measures, access controls, and data privacy protocols, adhering to industry best practices and regulatory requirements.

 You will define and deliver the digital strategy, roadmap and technology lifecycle for CREWS platforms such as IWMS/CAFM, CMMS, smart workplace, IoT, analytics and self\-service BI. You’ll work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to build intelligent systems that are robust, scalable, and aligned with UPS’s strategic goals.

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in one of the firm's largest identity modernization initiatives, helping onboard hundreds of applications into SailPoint while strengthening the company's security posture. You'll work on complex, enterprise\-scale integrations across cloud, SaaS, database, and on\-premises platforms, gaining exposure to a wide variety of technologies and business processes. The role offers significant opportunities to shape automation solutions, solve challenging technical problems, and directly influence how identity governance is delivered at scale. If you're passionate about SailPoint development, security engineering, and building solutions that have a measurable impact across the enterprise, you'll find both meaningful challenges and strong opportunities for growth
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* SailPoint Development \& Application Onboarding Design, develop, and implement application onboarding solutions within SailPoint IdentityIQ. Configure and maintain roles, entitlements, workflows, and access models. Support onboarding of on\-premises, cloud, and SaaS applications. Partner with business analysts and application teams to gather and implement technical requirements.
* IGA Engineering \& Integration Develop and maintain integrations between SailPoint and enterprise systems including Active Directory, LDAP, databases, APIs, and SaaS platforms. Build and support SailPoint rules, workflows, event handlers, and custom integration components. Configure provisioning, reconciliation, aggregation, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Automation \& Operational Excellence Develop automation solutions that improve onboarding efficiency and reduce manual effort. Support deployment activities and code promotion through multiple environments. Ensure solutions align with security, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Production Support \& Troubleshooting Investigate and resolve onboarding issues, provisioning failures, aggregation problems, and connectivity challenges. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventative solutions. Support application teams in troubleshooting and remediation efforts.
* Testing \& Deployment Support Participate in unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing activities. Assist with defect resolution and validation of onboarding solutions. Ensure quality standards are met before production deployment.
* Documentation \& Best Practices Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, deployment guides, and operational runbooks. Follow established development standards and onboarding processes. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Collaboration \& Mentorship Work closely with business analysts, application teams, security engineering teams, and project stakeholders. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and team members. SailPoint Development \& Application Onboarding Design, develop, and implement application onboarding solutions within SailPoint IdentityIQ.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* SailPoint \& IGA Experience 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA). 3\+ years of experience developing and supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ). Experience with application onboarding, entitlement management, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Development \& Integration Skills Strong Java development skills. Experience developing SailPoint rules, workflows, forms, and custom components. Experience integrating systems using REST and SOAP APIs. Knowledge of provisioning, reconciliation, aggregation, and identity governance concepts.
* Technical Skills Experience troubleshooting SailPoint implementations and integrations. Understanding of role\-based access control (RBAC), access certifications, and approval workflows. Knowledge of databases, SQL, and directory services.
* DevOps \& Delivery Experience using source control tools such as Git or Bitbucket. Familiarity with CI/CD processes and deployment practices. Experience working in Agile environments using Jira, Scrum, or Kanban.
* Communication \& Collaboration Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work effectively in cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams. Ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) or other legacy IGA platforms.
* Experience migrating applications from OIM to SailPoint IdentityIQ.
* Experience developing custom connectors and advanced SailPoint integrations.
* Familiarity with cloud identity technologies and modern authentication protocols.
* Experience supporting large\-scale application onboarding programs.
* Strong focus on automation, process improvement, and operational excellence


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: Reference Data Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make your mark strengthening client and counterparty data quality while building leadership skills in a fast\-paced operations team with strong mobility opportunities.
As a Party Reference Data Operations Analyst within Party Reference Data Operations, you will oversee the onboarding and lifecycle maintenance of client and counterparty reference static data with a focus on accuracy, controls, and service\-level agreement delivery. You will coordinate daily work queues, coach analysts through exceptions and escalations, and uphold documentation and authorization standards before processing requests. You will partner with stakeholders to resolve issues, improve upstream submission quality, and deliver management information on volumes, quality, and productivity to support continuous improvement.
**Job Responsibilities:**
* Oversee end\-to\-end delivery for onboarding and lifecycle maintenance activities, including setups, amendments, hierarchy changes, static data updates, mergers, and deactivations.
* Coordinate work allocation, queue management, and capacity balancing to meet productivity and quality targets.
* Validate that requests originate from authorized sources and meet minimum documentation requirements prior to processing.
* Apply procedural guidelines consistently and confirm supporting documentation is complete and appropriate before actioning requests.
* Implement quality assurance routines, including dual review, sampling, and trend analysis, to sustain accurate and complete reference data.
* Monitor open items, exceptions, and aging work to protect service levels and reduce operational risk.
* Escalate complex issues with clear status, root\-cause themes, and action plans to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain records and audit trails to support governance routines, reviews, and control testing.
* Partner with requestors and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, remediate exceptions, and improve submission quality.
* Produce management information covering volumes, productivity, service\-level agreement adherence, quality outcomes, and exception themes.
* Coach team members through training support, ongoing feedback, and a culture of accuracy, ownership, and continuous improvement.


**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**
* Earn a university degree.
* Bring 3\+ years of experience in financial services or a closely related industry.
* Demonstrate fluency in written and spoken English.
* Communicate clearly and professionally in verbal and written formats.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail when processing, reviewing, and updating reference data.
* Analyze operational issues to support accurate exception handling and remediation activity.
* Use standard productivity tools confidently, including spreadsheet software.
* Apply basic knowledge of financial industry concepts in day\-to\-day processing and stakeholder interactions.
* Collaborate effectively within a team environment to deliver consistent outcomes.
* Follow established procedures and control requirements to support well\-controlled execution.


**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**
* Show hands\-on exposure to low\-code or no\-code tools for workflow automation, forms, lightweight applications, and dashboarding.
* Leverage advanced spreadsheet capabilities, including macros, to improve tracking, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Translate operational needs into simple automation ideas and partner effectively with technology teams to implement them.
* Developing experience using AI\-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Analyst, Product Manager Schemes, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**
 DBS Bank has been present in India for over 30 years, opening its first office in Mumbai in 1994\. DBS Bank India Limited is the first among the large foreign banks in India to operate as a wholly owned, locally incorporated subsidiary of a leading global bank. As a trusted partner, DBS provides a comprehensive range of banking services for large, medium, and small enterprises, as well as individual consumers, focusing on seamless customer experiences that help customers "Live more, Bank less."
   

  

 As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is uniquely positioned to help customers realize their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS offers a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards, personal loans, and government\-backed financial inclusion initiatives, helping customers achieve their financial aspirations at every life stage.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Product Manager \- PM Schemes will be responsible for driving the end\-to\-end management, performance, compliance, and lifecycle administration of Government\-backed social security schemes including Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), and Atal Pension Yojana (APY).
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with business, operations, technology, insurance partners, and regulatory bodies to ensure seamless customer experience, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and sustainable business growth across all PM Schemes.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Manage the complete lifecycle of PMJJBY, PMSBY, and APY products across acquisition, servicing, renewals, claims, and reporting.
* Drive scheme penetration and sales performance across branches by monitoring targets and productivity metrics.
* Enhance and manage bank systems and digital platforms supporting PM Scheme processes and customer journeys.
* Ensure seamless integration and compliance with Government and regulatory portals including the Jan Suraksha Portal.
* Collaborate with Operations teams to ensure smooth execution of renewals, premium collections, policy activations, and customer servicing.
* Manage relationships with insurance partners and vendors to ensure efficient service delivery and claims management.
* Ensure compliance with RBI regulations, Ministry of Finance guidelines, PFRDA requirements, and internal bank policies.
* Deliver timely management reporting, business analytics, and regulatory submissions.
* Drive customer satisfaction through effective grievance management and timely resolution of customer concerns.


**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Manage product enhancements, system upgrades, and process improvements related to PM Schemes within internal banking platforms.
* Design and implement efficient customer onboarding, enrollment, servicing, and claims processes.
* Coordinate with Technology and Operations teams to support digital and branch\-led enrollment journeys.
* Monitor branch sales performance and drive achievement of business objectives through regular reviews and engagement.
* Conduct product training and capability\-building sessions for branches and sales teams.
* Work closely with Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve outreach and customer enrollment across geographies.
* Monitor policy issuance, premium collections, remittances, and policy activations with insurance partners.
* Ensure adherence to agreed service standards and turnaround times for claims servicing and grievance resolution.
* Prepare and submit regulatory reports and business MIS to RBI, Ministry of Finance, DFS, and internal management stakeholders.
* Develop dashboards and analytics to provide actionable business insights and performance monitoring.
* Manage customer grievances through Jan Suraksha Portal and ensure timely closure of complaints.
* Oversee the complete APY lifecycle including PRAN generation, contribution management, fund remittances, upgrades, downgrades, exits, and account closures.
* Ensure all operational activities are conducted in line with regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and governance frameworks.


**Requirements**
* Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or Product Management functions.
* Strong understanding of Government social security schemes, banking products, and customer servicing processes.
* Experience in process design, workflow management, and system implementation initiatives.
* Strong analytical skills with exposure to MIS, reporting, and business performance monitoring.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to banking and Government schemes.
* Experience in stakeholder management across business, operations, technology, and external partners.
* Strong customer orientation with a focus on operational excellence and service delivery.


**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Finance, Banking, or equivalent preferred.


**Core Competencies**
* Product \& Process Management
* Business Performance Management
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills
* Customer\-Centric Mindset
* Communication \& Training Capabilities
* Project Management \& Execution Excellence
* Attention to Detail \& Governance Focus


**Technical Competencies**
* Understanding of banking products and Government welfare schemes.
* Knowledge of PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY, and associated regulatory guidelines.
* Understanding of RBI, Ministry of Finance, DFS, and PFRDA regulations.
* Experience with MIS reporting, dashboard creation, and business analytics.
* Knowledge of digital onboarding systems, workflow management, and process automation.
* Familiarity with operational risk, audit, KYC, and compliance frameworks.


**Work Relationship**
* Close interaction with Retail Banking, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and Customer Service teams.
* Regular engagement with Insurance Partners, Government Agencies, and Regulatory Bodies.
* Collaboration with Branch Banking channels and Business Correspondents to drive scheme penetration and customer acquisition.
* Partnership with Data, Analytics, and Reporting teams to monitor business and regulatory performance metrics.


**DBS India – Culture \& Behaviours**
* Demonstrate business performance through PRIDE 2\.0 value\-based propositions.
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers and reducing complaints.
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain, and enhance DBS’s reputation.
* Continuously enhance knowledge, skills, and competencies.
* Execute with speed while maintaining operational excellence and accuracy.
* Uphold the highest standards of honesty, integrity, governance, and professionalism.

description:
**Company Description** **CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. Mattel is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented **Workday HRIS Consultant** with expertise in **Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security** to support the design, configuration, enhancement, and ongoing administration of our global Workday platform. This role will partner closely with HR, Total Rewards, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve employee experience, ensure data integrity, and support organizational growth.


The ideal candidate will possess strong Workday functional expertise, problem\-solving skills, and a passion for optimizing HR technology through continuous improvement and innovation.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Workday Configuration \& Administration**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security modules.
* Design and implement business process changes, condition rules, calculated fields, notifications, and security configurations.
* Support Workday releases, perform impact analysis, regression testing, and feature adoption.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions aligned with best practices.

**Compensation Management**

* Support annual compensation planning cycles, merit processes, bonus programs, and compensation reviews.
* Configure compensation eligibility rules, compensation grades, plans, and related business processes.
* Partner with Total Rewards teams to implement compensation\-related enhancements and process improvements.
* Troubleshoot compensation\-related issues and provide timely resolutions.

**Security Administration**

* Configure and maintain domain and business process security policies.
* Manage role\-based security assignments and perform periodic security audits.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements.
* Support security reviews, segregation\-of\-duty controls, and risk mitigation initiatives.

**Reporting \& Data Management**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.
* Ensure HR data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across Workday modules.
* Analyze workforce and compensation data to support business decision\-making.
* Support internal and external audit requests through accurate reporting and documentation.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with HR, Payroll, Compensation, Talent, and IT teams to identify system enhancement opportunities.
* Provide functional guidance and recommendations based on Workday best practices.
* Support global HR initiatives, system implementations, and organizational changes.
* Deliver end\-user support and training for Workday processes and functionality.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes through automation and system enhancements.
* Stay current with Workday releases and emerging HR technology trends.
* Participate in HR transformation and digitalization initiatives.

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 3\-7 years of hands\-on experience supporting Workday HCM implementations and production support environments.
* Proven experience configuring and administering:
	+ Workday Core HCM
	+ Workday Compensation
	+ Workday Security
* Experience supporting global HR operations and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with Workday business processes, condition rules, calculated fields, and security frameworks.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Workday security architecture, domains, business process security, and role assignments.
* Experience supporting merit, bonus, and compensation review cycles within Workday.
* Advanced reporting expertise using Workday Report Writer and calculated fields.
* Experience with EIBs, data loads, and mass data updates.
* Strong Excel skills including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis techniques.
* Exposure to HR technology automation and AI\-enabled solutions.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality solutions.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro or Workday Certification in HCM, Compensation, or Security.
* Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles.
* Exposure to Workday Prism Analytics or People Analytics.
* Experience working in consumer products, retail, manufacturing, or global enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with Workday integrations, Studio, Core Connectors, and Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB).
* Knowledge of Agile project methodologies.
* Experience participating in Workday implementations, enhancement projects, or HR transformation initiatives.

 **Additional Information**  

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  

  

**How We Work:**  

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**  

We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

**Who We Are:**  

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.


Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.


Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.  

  

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

title: Embedded Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
**Your Impact**
 You will be working on sophisticated, industrial, real\-time systems involving embedded hardware and software platforms, automated validation, and simulation of field conditions. This team of engineers develops innovative monitoring systems used for Grid Monitoring, Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), and Generation applications in electrical substations and power plants.
   

  

**Here’s Where You’ll Demonstrate Your Proficiencies**
* Validation and verification of embedded systems incorporating ARM\-based processors, microcontrollers, Linux\-based platforms, and analog/digital I/O subsystems.
* Design, development, and execution of test plans for hardware components integrated with firmware and software.
* Development of automated test tools, test frameworks, and simulation environments for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and system\-level testing.
* Execution of integration testing across hardware, firmware, networking, and application software layers.
* Support for regulatory and compliance testing activities, including CE, UL, IEC, IEEE, EMC, and environmental verification.
* Investigation and root\-cause analysis of complex system issues using electrical test equipment, protocol analysis tools, network monitoring tools, and system logs.
* Collaboration with hardware, firmware, software, and systems engineering teams to ensure robust product validation and long\-term reliability.
* Use of Agile Scrum methodologies to support validation activities, continuous improvement, and product quality initiatives.


**Qualifications**
 The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
* Minimum four years of industry experience, including at least three years in embedded systems validation, hardware verification, or test automation within a laboratory or production environment.
* Strong understanding of embedded systems, digital and analogue electronics, and electrical engineering principles.
* Experience developing automated test solutions using scripting or programming languages such as Python, C\#, LabVIEW, or similar.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive high\-performance validation strategies.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, interpersonal, and technical communication skills.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with cabinet wiring, electrical safety, circuit protection, and industrial control systems.
* Hands\-on experience using oscilloscopes, digital multi\-meters (DMMs), signal generators, and other laboratory instrumentation for verification and validation activities.
* Experience with networking equipment, managed Ethernet switches, GPS, PTP, NTP, or other precision timing technologies.
* Experience troubleshooting network communications using packet capture and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Experience with industrial communication protocols including IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, and related testing methodologies.
* Experience developing automated test harnesses, regression test systems, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test environments.
* Familiarity with protocol testing tools such as IEC Browser, IED Scout, Modbus Poll, and Modbus Slave.
* Exposure to fault location, digital fault recording (DFR), power quality (PQ), synchrophasor (PMU), condition monitoring, or other grid power system applications.
* Experience with Linux\-based embedded platforms and use of version control tools such as Git.
* Knowledge of serial communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, or RS\-485\.
* Exposure to cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessment, secure communications protocols, or IEC 62443 requirements would be advantageous.


**About Ralliant**
 Ralliant stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next\-generation breakthroughs to life—faster, smarter, and more reliably.

We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for people to join our Data \& Analytics department to participate in end to\-end commercialization projects covering pre\-launch, launch and post launch activities.

description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Project Manager CPMO tools \& AI enablement**
* Location: Ind\- Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Opella Digital is executing a multi\-year transformation program (Butterfly: 56 programs, 205\+ projects) supported by an integrated PMO \& OCM unit. The tooling landscape underpinning this transformation — Planisware, Jira, Confluence, PowerBI, and the ELITEA, OpellaGPT AI platforms — has been designed and initially built by our implementation partner EPAM.
   

  

 We are now internalizing this capability. The PMO \& CMO Tools and Enablement Lead will act as the Product Owner and Project Manager of the full tooling ecosystem. You will not build the tools yourself — dedicated tech teams handle Planisware, Jira/Confluence, PowerBI, and OpellaGPT implementation. Your job is to gather requirements from all stakeholders across the Digital organization, translate them into actionable specifications, prioritize them, and project\-manage their implementation by the right tech teams.
   

  

 You are the bridge between business needs (what PMO, programme streams, OCM, and project teams need to see and do) and the technical teams that make it happen. You need a strong understanding of the underlying technology — not to code, but to know what’s possible, what’s feasible, and how systems connect. You think in data flows, integration patterns, and user requirements — then you drive delivery.
   

  

 A defining requirement of this role is to be an AI champion. Beyond running the tooling ecosystem, you are expected to actively drive the conversion of manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool ways of working toward AI\-assisted and automated workflows — using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected platforms — and to make AI and automation the default way the PMO and OCM operate. This expectation is weighted heavily in the recruitment process: candidates without a demonstrable AI\-automation track record are not a fit.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Requirements Gathering \& Product Ownership
* Act as the single Product Owner for the PMO \& CMO tooling ecosystem — own the backlog, prioritize features, and define what gets built and in what order
* Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple stakeholder layers: PMO dashboards, Butterfly stream dashboards, OCM/change management needs, project\-level dashboards, programme\-level reporting, DLT/SteerCo views
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications and user stories that tech teams can implement
* Manage the requirements lifecycle: elicitation, documentation, validation, prioritization, change control
* Facilitate workshops and requirement sessions with stakeholders across PMO, OCM, programme streams, and leadership to understand their reporting, tracking, and tooling needs
* Maintain a prioritized product backlog for the tooling ecosystem — balancing competing demands from PMO, OCM, and programme stakeholders
* Define acceptance criteria and validate delivered solutions against requirements before release
* AI Enablement \& Automation (Core Mandate)
* Champion AI and automation across the PMO and OCM — set the ambition, build momentum, demonstrate quick wins, and convert sceptics into adopters.
* Audit current ways of working and identify manual, template\-based, and legacy\-tool processes that are candidates for automation.
* Drive the conversion of those processes to AI\-assisted and automated workflows using OpellaGPT, ELITEA, and connected tooling — automated reporting and status roll\-ups, AI\-enabled change analytics, document and template generation.
* Embed AI into standard operating practice rather than leaving it as an optional add\-on; make automation the default, not the exception.
* Define and track AI\-adoption and conversion metrics (e.g. share of manual reports automated, hours saved, adoption rates) and report progress to the Head of PM Practice.
* Stay ahead of emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, ELITEA, PowerBI AI features) and translate them into practical improvements for the delivery and change teams.
* Project Management of Tooling Implementations
* Project\-manage the implementation of requirements across multiple tech teams: Planisware team, Jira/Confluence team, PowerBI team, OpellaGPT/ELITEA team, and any future platform teams
* Coordinate delivery across tech teams — manage dependencies, timelines, and integration points between platforms
* Track delivery progress, manage risks and issues, escalate blockers, and ensure on\-time delivery of tooling features
* Own the release management process — coordinate deployments across platforms, ensure regression testing, and manage rollout communication
* Manage the phased evolution of the reporting pipeline: from Phase 1 (manual) to Phase 2 (MCP/OpenAPI connectors) to Phase 3 (Planisware\-Jira synchronization)
* Coordinate with the Solution Architect on technical feasibility, platform evolution roadmap, and integration architecture
* Data Architecture Understanding \& Integration Design
* Understand where every datapoint lives across the ecosystem — Planisware (portfolio, schedules, budgets), Jira (project tracking, status), Confluence (governance), Snowflake (analytics), LMS (training completion), Veeva (content), knowledge platforms
* Design integration requirements: specify what data needs to flow between systems, in what direction, at what frequency, and in what format — then hand off to tech teams for implementation
* Understand the three\-layer reporting architecture: Data Layer → Orchestration Layer (ELITEA/OpellaGPT) → Presentation Layer (dashboards, PowerBI, Confluence) — and ensure requirements are correctly placed in the right layer
* Define data quality requirements and validation rules for the tooling ecosystem — ensure a consistent data baseline across the global portfolio
* Evaluate and recommend integration patterns (MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL) based on technical feasibility and business priority
* Ensure portability of data pipelines and workflows to future platforms (OpellaGPT) as those platforms mature
* CMO Tooling — Requirements \& Delivery
* Gather requirements from the OCM/Change team for the CMO tooling layer — understand what they need for change readiness tracking, adoption measurement, training management, and stakeholder engagement
* Understand enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS), Veeva, and knowledge platforms at a functional level — know what data they produce and how to specify integrations with the reporting ecosystem
* Translate CMO requirements into specifications for the relevant tech teams (PowerBI for dashboards, Confluence for templates, OpellaGPT for AI\-enabled change analytics)
* Project\-manage the build of CMO tools: change saturation heatmaps, adoption dashboards, training completion tracking, readiness assessments — as specified by the Central Change Manager
* Ensure CMO data feeds into the existing PMO dashboards — change readiness metrics, training completion, and adoption data visible alongside delivery data
* Unlock the benefits of AI solutions for OCM (OpellaGPT) — gather requirements for AI\-enabled change enablement, reporting, and analytics
* Stakeholder Management \& Training
* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders (PMO, OCM, programme streams, PMs) and the tech teams that implement tooling solutions
* Manage expectations across stakeholders — communicate priorities, timelines, trade\-offs, and delivery status
* Train project teams on how to use PMO and CMO tools — where to find them, how to use them, how to submit data at stage gates (the OCM team owns the content; this role owns the tooling how\-to)
* Develop self\-service training materials: guides, video walkthroughs, quick\-reference cards for both PMO and CMO tools
* Lead Communities of Practice sessions focused on tooling best practices and adoption
* Support new PM onboarding with tooling setup and orientation (coordinated with the Delivery Facilitation Lead)
* Continuous Improvement
* Continuously improve the tooling landscape based on user feedback, emerging platform capabilities (OpellaGPT, PowerBI, ELITEA), and evolving programme needs
* Monitor tool adoption rates and flag under\-utilization to the Head of PM Practice
* Conduct periodic reviews of the tooling ecosystem with key stakeholders to identify gaps, redundancies, and improvement opportunities


**Technical Environment**
**This Role Requires Understanding Of The Following Platforms**
**Portfolio Management**
 Planisware (schedules, budgets, dependencies, milestones) — dedicated Planisware team implements
   

  

**Project Tracking**
 Jira Cloud Enterprise (epics, stories, status, RAG) — dedicated Jira/Confluence team implements
   

  

**Collaboration \& Docs**
 Confluence Cloud (governance pages, templates, documentation)
   

  

**Data Warehouse**
 Snowflake (analytical data, portfolio ingestion)
   

  

**AI / Orchestration**
 ELITEA Platform, OpellaGPT — dedicated AI team implements
   

  

**Reporting / BI**
 PowerBI, self\-contained HTML dashboards, Confluence publishing — dedicated BI team implements
   

  

**CMO / Change Platforms**
 LMS (Learning Management Systems), Veeva, knowledge platforms — data integration, not content creation
   

  

**Integration Patterns**
 MCP connectors, OpenAPI, webhooks, ETL — understand and specify, tech teams implement
   

  

**About You**
* 6\+ years of experience in business analysis, project management, or product ownership in an enterprise IT/Digital environment
* Demonstrable track record of driving AI and automation adoption — converting manual, template\-based, or legacy\-tool processes into AI\-assisted or automated workflows, with evidence of results. This is an essential, defining requirement of the role.
* Proven ability to gather, translate, and prioritize requirements from multiple business stakeholders with competing needs
* Experience project\-managing implementations across multiple technical teams working on different platforms simultaneously
* Strong understanding of enterprise project/portfolio management tools (Planisware, Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) — not as a developer, but as someone who understands their capabilities, data models, and integration possibilities

 Develops, defines, and executes plans of record, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks that includes. Monitors budget/spending, on\-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.

**Organization Description**
 Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Senior Manager Digital \& Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC plays a critical role in Marriott’s Digital and Technology Transformation, reporting to Vice President, Operations, South Asia, with a dotted line to Director of Rooms Operations, APEC, based in Mumbai, Bangalore or New Delhi.
   

  

 This role will provide a bridge between current and future processes in Rooms Operations, guiding hotels on the deployment of the new systems and business processes, supporting the guest and associate journey to ensure a smooth transition and cutover. The role will conduct workshops and trainings to transitioning hotels, ensuring that property teams are fully prepared to successfully operate the new systems from Day 1\.
   

  

 To accomplish this, the Senior Manager Digital \& Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC will develop subject matter expertise covering the end\-to\-end systems and processes for the Associates to deliver great guest experiences, including Opera Cloud PMS, EMPOWER GXP, SPOG, and ARA and Loyalty Operations, and to use the knowledge to support hotel teams across APEC. The successful candidate is required to possess a deep knowledge of existing operations within APEC and the systems that support it, including Opera PMS, MARSHA, EMPOWER GXP, EMPOWER ResApp, and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program. Furthermore, the role will understand the shift from MARSHA to Amadeus Central Reservation System (ACRS), and the effects of the change on Rooms tasks, including guaranteed attributes, non\-room products, etc.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Testing and Product Validation: Contribute to end\-to\-end business process validation testing for the discipline, collaborating with relevant stakeholders in DGE, Rooms Operations, and Loyalty Operations disciplines in APEC
* End\-to\-End Deployment Validation:
* Lead validation of deployment resources, Land\-It tasks, and other items to ensure deployment readiness
* Align required changes with relevant stakeholders
* Digital Learning Path: Partner with Learning and Development (L\&D) to ensure property associates receive the training assignments, resources, and system accesses required for their particular roles.
* Workshop Facilitation \& Training: Lead interactive operations workshops and webinars (virtual and/or in\-person) for property teams to facilitate training, share best practices, and address common challenges
* Property Support: Act as the SME for property Operations teams, providing timely responses to property questions and triaging challenges raised by properties
* Deployment Support
* Work closely with Implementation Managers (IMs) during the deployment, focusing on critical task validation and knowledge transfer with property and discipline teams during the Prepare and Ready phases
* Assist with Command Center operations during the Launch phase, ensuring operational queries and support tickets are resolved promptly
* Continue supporting IMs and discipline teams throughout the Stabilization phase, helping properties adapt to new business processes and tools
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Change Management
* Act as a trusted advisor to property operators and deployment teams.
* Communicate complex system concepts in clear, actionable terms.
* Collaboration across other SMEs (including Revenue, Reservations, Group, Sales, Events, Finance, and IT) is essential.
* Gather feedback from early adopters and share insights to improve future workshops and deployment processes.
* Foster a collaborative, supportive learning environment.
* Materials \& Continuous Improvement
* Utilize and continuously refine workshop facilitation materials, participant guides, and job aids.
* Contribute to the development of new learning content and process documentation.


**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
* Technical \& Functional Expertise
+ Deep knowledge of existing operations within APEC and the systems that support it, including Opera PMS, MARSHA, EMPOWER: GXP, EMPOWER: RES, and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program.
+ Ability to quickly learn and build expertise in the new systems and processes that create the entire end\-to\-end experience for Rooms associates, including Opera Cloud PMS, SPOG, and ARA

* Change Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
+ Proven ability to lead hotels and operations teams through complex system and process changes, articulating what is changing and what is staying the same.
+ Skilled in training, stakeholder communication, and change enablement strategies.
+ Strong influencing skills with the ability to align cross functional teams across disciplines.

* Problem\-Solving \& Decision\-Making
+ Analytical thinker with strong root cause analysis skills and structured risk mitigation approach.
+ Comfortable operating in fast paced, ambiguous environments.
+ Strong judgment to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

* Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Partnership
+ Ability to build strong relationships across regional teams and hotel teams.
+ Comfortable bridging the gap between business requirements, product design, and technical stakeholders.
+ Collaborative mindset focused on shared outcomes and continuous improvement.

* Communication \& Facilitation
+ Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills tailored to both operational and executive audiences.
+ Ability to simplify complex concepts and provide clear direction during implementation and support phases.
+ Confident facilitator of workshops, discussions, and rapid problem solving sessions.

* Adaptability \& Resilience
+ Effective in dynamic deployment environments with competing priorities.
+ Resilient under pressure, maintaining a positive, proactive approach.
+ Strong sense of ownership and drive for operational excellence.

**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Machine Learning Engineer to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). Are you looking to work at the forefront of Machine Learning and AI? Would you be excited to apply Generative AI algorithms to solve real world problems with significant impact? In this role, you'll work directly with customers to design, evangelize, implement, and scale AI/ML solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their AI transformation journey, providing deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 As a Machine Learning Engineer within the AWS Professional Services organization, you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure machine learning solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll help customers imagine and scope the use cases that will create the greatest value for their businesses, select and train and fine tune the right models, and define paths to navigate technical or business challenges. Working closely with stakeholders, you'll assess current data infrastructure, develop proof\-of\-concepts, and propose effective strategies for implementing AI and generative AI solutions at scale. You will design and run experiments, research new algorithms, and find new ways of optimizing risk, profitability, and customer experience.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 A successful candidate will be a person who enjoys diving deep into data, doing analysis, discovering root causes, and designing long\-term solutions. It will be a person who likes to have fun, loves to learn, and wants to innovate in the world of AI. Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Understand the customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .
* Assist customers by being able to deliver a AI/Ml and GenAI project from beginning to end, including understanding the business need, aggregating data, exploring data, building \& validating predictive models, and deploying completed models to deliver business impact to the organization.
* Use Deep Learning frameworks like MXNet, Caffe 2, Tensorflow, Theano, CNTK, and Keras to help our customers build DL models.
* Use SparkML and Amazon Machine Learning (AML) to help our customers build ML models.
* Use Amazon Bedrock and various GenAI Tools to help customers build GenAI Applications.
* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data.
* Work with our DevOps consultants to help our customers operationalize models after they are built.
* Assist customers with identifying model drift and retraining models.


 A day in the life
   

  

 This is a customer facing role. You will be required to travel to client locations and deliver professional services as needed.
   

  

**About The Team**
 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of IT implementation experience
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* 7\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
* 7\+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* 7\+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* 1\+ years of professional work experience, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience with automation (e.g., Terraform, Python), Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, CDK), and Containers \& CI/CD Pipelines
* Experience building applications using GenAI technologies (LLMs, Vector Stores, LangChain, Prompt Engineering)
* Experience building ML pipelines with MLOps best practices, including: data preprocessing, model hosting, feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, distributed \& GPU training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining

description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**About Candescent**
 Candescent is the leading cloud\-based digital banking solutions provider for financial institutions. We are transforming digital banking with intelligent, cloud\-powered solutions that connect account opening, digital banking, and branch experiences for financial institutions. Our advanced technology and developer tools enable seamless, differentiated customer journeys that elevate trust, service, and innovation. Success here requires flexibility in a fast\-paced environment, a client\-first mindset, and a commitment to delivering consistent, reliable results as part of a performance\-driven, values\-led team. With team members around the world, Candescent is an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER \- Consumer**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Product Summary**
 Our mission is to deliver a leading, end\-to\-end consumer banking experience through a mobile\-first, intuitive, and secure digital platform that enables financial institutions to personalize and scale services to meet their customers' evolving needs
   

  

 We will achieve this by designing and evolving the leading Consumer digital banking experience. We will focus on simplifying financial tasks, empowering users with insights and control, and giving financial institutions the flexibility to launch, manage, and grow their digital banking channel.
   

  

 With personalized experiences, a best\-in\-class feature set, and continuous innovation, we will continue to future\-proof our customers by leveraging emerging technologies and ecosystem advancements.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality
* Document business requirements using the company's software development tools and methodology


**Product P\&L and Pricing**
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to manage product profitability and performance, ensuring alignment with short\- and long\-term product objectives and roadmaps


**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**
* Gather customer and user needs, along with market research, to inform the product vision and strategy created by the Product Manager
* Use the product vision and insights to define product features and prioritize the team’s backlog


**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility
* Continuously refine the product backlog by analyzing value versus effort
* Define acceptance criteria and validate that features and stories meet user quality standards
* Drive product development in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and engage stakeholders (e.g., PMs, other POs, functions) to manage dependencies and resolve issues


**Qualifications**
* Fintech/ Next Gen Mobile
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 10\+ years of experience in the finance industry, preferably with large\-scale digital, online, or mobile banking applications for consumers or small businesses
* Strong understanding of complex business and technical problems
* Proven experience delivering software products through the definition, design, and release cycle
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with industry standards such as PCI, WCAG, and FFIEC
* Strong leadership, project management, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Deep understanding of user and business needs to create and prioritize user stories that deliver value
* Ability to prioritize based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility


**Product Specific Qualifications / Skillsets**
* Deep understanding of mobile best practices
* Familiar with the benefits and limitations of React and React Native libraries
* Experience working on a consumer facing web or mobile application
* Experience working with a white\-labelled product is desired

Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

description:
As a market leader in providing illiquid portfolio analysis, our Alternative Asset Management professionals assist clients in the valuation of alternative investments, specifically for securities and positions for which there are no active market quotations available. Our professionals have the opportunity to work on a wide range of projects with exposure to the bespoke investment structures and asset classes of our institutional investor clientele.
   

  

 Kroll's
 **Financial Instruments and Technology (complex securities valuation)** 
 practice is a leading solutions provider for asset managers, hedge funds, fund administrators, banks, insurers, private equity firms, commodity trading and investment firms, and corporations. We are looking for Analyst’s who will be involved in providing support to our global valuation practice.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
 The Analyst will assist on a range of valuation advisory services to the alternative asset community and gain exposure to exciting the esoteric nature of such positions. Responsibilities include:
   

  

* Developing deep technical strength in the valuation of alternative assets, through direct exposure to high\-profile clients and alternative asset industry professionals
* Reviewing investment memoranda, governing documents of structured investments, board of directors’ presentations, and client models
* Assisting the team with interviewing clients, including preparing information request lists, participating in face\-to\-face meetings, to gather data and information pertinent to the engagement
* Assisting in the design of financial models for discounted cash flow, market multiple, market transaction and option pricing analyses
* Performing valuation analysis on a wide range of illiquid investments broadly distributed across industries and geographies while using accepted and relevant approaches and theory
* Compiling statistical summaries of companies’ financial information, developing and computing financial ratios, and presenting the analyses in an organized manner and/or using our standard formats and presentations
* Working with management to build, develop, and maintain client relationships
* Reporting and presenting analyses and conclusions including written reports, including assisting in the presentation of work products and conclusions internally to clients
* Attending relevant industry events to broaden your knowledge and experience within the alternative asset community


**Essential Traits**
* CA, Master's degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics or equivalent thereof (e.g., CFA); or MBA from an accredited college/university
* Minimum 0\-1 year of experience constructing and reviewing valuation models and other financial models including: enterprise valuation using DCF \& market approaches, and other structured investment models
* Experience with credit analysis or structured securities experience is a plus: CLOs, CMBS, RMBS, ABS, etc., Intex or other tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, as well as strong verbal and written communication skills
* A fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Excellent understanding of financial statements analysis with the ability to work through key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations
* Excellent attention to detail, strong work ethic, and ability to manage multiple ongoing assignments efficiently and accurately
* Familiarity with relevant accounting standards and policies produced and amended from time to time by the AICPA and other oversight bodies
* Knowledge of software packages including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Direct experience working with VBA, Python, and Power BI is highly desirable
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills that help represent diverse communities
* Experience working with diverse teams


**About Kroll**
 Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
