description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success\-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 We are looking for an experienced Lead Automation Test Engineer to join our Data Platform Teams in Noida, acting as the go\-to quality and test automation expert across the platform. You will build and drive automated testing for UI, APIs, and data — including platforms such as Snowflake and SQL\-based stores — and make testing a natural, built\-in part of how we deliver, rather than an afterthought bolted on at the end. You will enable other engineers to test effectively, create transparency into quality and coverage across the data platform, and help embed testing into our CI/CD pipelines so issues are caught early and consistently. You will work in an agile environment, partnering closely with data engineers, while also being comfortable owning initiatives on your own.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Lead the design, build, and optimization of automated test suites across UI, API, and data layers, including data validation and reconciliation testing against Snowflake and other SQL\-based platforms
* Define and drive the test automation strategy for the data platform, setting shared standards and best practices adopted across multiple teams
* Embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines so quality gates run consistently as part of every build, release, and deployment
* Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to define testing requirements and ensure alignment with business
* Create transparency around test coverage, quality metrics, and known risks — through dashboards, reporting, and clear communication to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Enable and mentor other engineers to write and maintain their own automated tests, raising the overall quality bar across teams rather than being the sole tester
* Collaborate closely with developers, data engineers, and architects to identify testing gaps and design testable systems from the outset
* Troubleshoot test failures and flaky tests, and continuously improve the reliability and speed of automated test suites
* Contribute to documentation, best practices, and knowledge sharing on testing and quality across the data platform organization


**Key Skills And Requirements**
* 8\+ years of practical experience setting up testing frameworks and writing automated tests for UI (e.g. SpecFlow) and API (e.g. REST Assured or similar)
* Solid SQL skills and practical experience testing data platforms such as Snowflake, including data validation, reconciliation, and pipeline testing
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) so testing runs as a natural part of build and release
* Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision and lead test strategy across multiple teams, while also collaborating effectively with developers, data engineers, and stakeholders
* Clear communication skills — able to explain testing strategy, coverage, and risk clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Experience mentoring or enabling other engineers to adopt good testing practices
* Programming/scripting skills (e.g. Python, Java, C\#) to build and maintain test frameworks and tooling


 Desirable:
   

  

* Experience with test reporting and quality dashboards
* Finance or investment management domain knowledge
* Genuine interest in AI, with practical experience using AI tools to speed up test creation and maintenance


**What We Value**
* Enablement over gatekeeping \- you help other teams test well rather than being the sole quality checkpoint
* Transparency \- you make quality and test coverage visible and easy to understand for everyone
* Ownership \& continuous improvement \- you take end\-to\-end responsibility for test quality and constantly look to automate and simplify
* Clear communication \- you explain your reasoning and findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike


**Other Requirements**
* Flexibility in working hours
* Hybrid working arrangements (at least 2x a week in the office)


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career \& Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

 Technical Skills

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a driven, strategic, technical Network Acquisition Manager with experience supporting a high\-growth technology business. This position will work within the Network Acquisition and Delivery team within OCI Networking and will independently manage the acquisition and delivery of key network infrastructure North America. A successful candidate will have a blend of business knowledge, vendor relationships, regional expertise and technical skills that enables them to deliver mission critical network infrastructure to support Oracle's growth in the regions mentioned. The ideal candidate will operate independently across our organization, partnering with other leaders within Networking, Data Center, Region Build, Engineering and Operations. They will also be responsible developing internal interval measurement mechanisms, while leading the team to improve efficiencies in the delivery process.
   

  

 At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer\-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world.
   

  

 Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions. We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future.
   

  

 You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you’ll belong and be encouraged.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Manage a vendor and a circuit delivery pipeline to deploy crucial network infrastructure on/before time for Oracle’s internal and external customers
   

  

 Leverage regional knowledge and vendor relationships to drive critical deliveries on time
   

  

 Work across teams to design and launch new processes, institute process improvements and automation, and ensure the achievement of process objectives.
   

  

 Abstract, organize, and structure process, objectives, and workflows.
   

  

 Create and automate reporting, including monthly business reviews (MBRs).
   

  

 Run programs independently, including critical projects, executive project reporting and execution.
   

  

 Manage both technical and non\-technical projects.
   

  

 Identify and remove blockers for Oracle teams in the region
   

  

**Key Qualifications**
 6\+ years of experience delivering network infrastructure in the Telecom, Datacenter, or Cloud Infrastructure industries.
   

  

 Experience working cross functional with engineering, operations, and capacity planning teams.
   

  

 The ability to document metrics and recommendations to internal technical leadership as well as VPs and SVPs
   

  

 Ability to work independently and propose solutions.
   

  

 Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
   

  

 Highly proficient in Jira, Excel, PowerPoint, and Confluence.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care.  True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.

Oversees and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement and monitor software and tools. Manages the implementation of divisional products. Manages the evaluation and selection of IT vendor products. Partners with leaders to strategize and effectively shape IT demand that will deliver business impact.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced technology leader to build, scale, and lead multiple engineering teams responsible for developing enterprise data services and API\-driven platforms that power critical business capabilities.
   

  

 This role combines engineering leadership, technology strategy, and large\-scale delivery accountability. The successful candidate will partner with business and technology stakeholders to drive platform modernization, establish engineering best practices, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-performing solutions. The position requires a strong blend of people leadership, technical expertise, stakeholder management, and program execution within a complex and highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and develop multiple software engineering teams, fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
* Drive the design, development, delivery, and operational support of enterprise data services, APIs, and business\-critical technology platforms.
* Partner with business leaders, product teams, and architects to define technology strategy, roadmaps, and long\-term engineering direction.
* Lead large\-scale platform modernization and API transformation initiatives aimed at improving scalability, reliability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, governance models, and quality frameworks across teams.
* Provide leadership throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, execution, release management, production readiness, and operational support.
* Build and manage high\-performing teams, including hiring, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Develop strong relationships with global stakeholders and drive alignment across geographically distributed teams.
* Monitor delivery performance through meaningful operational and engineering metrics, ensuring business commitments and service objectives are met.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate delivery, operational, and technology risks across complex initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve engineering effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Oversee vendor and partner relationships where required and ensure successful delivery against agreed objectives.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in IT delivery, project management, or technology leadership roles, with expertise in software implementation and team management.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; Master’s degree in Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.
* Proven experience leading large engineering organizations and managing multiple software development teams.
* Strong program management, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise APIs, service\-oriented architectures, microservices, or large\-scale integration platforms.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to partner effectively with architects and senior engineering leaders to define technology strategy and engineering standards.
* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or enterprise technology initiatives.
* Experience working within Banking, Financial Services, Investment Management, Insurance, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies, modern software architecture patterns, API platforms, data services, and distributed systems.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build high\-performing teams and deliver complex technology programs in fast\-paced enterprise environments.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

**Our mission**
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

**Our commitment to you**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

**Physical wellness**
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

**Personal wellness**
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

**How We Work**

We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced Sourcing Specialist to join our team at Randstad Enterprise supporting North America(NAM) region. The ideal candidate will have 4\+ years of recruitment experience, strong sourcing and research skills, and the ability to identify, engage, and screen top talent for Fortune 500 clients.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about talent sourcing, enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, and have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, we’d love to hear from you!
 



  





**Position Summary** 




  





**Role** 
 : Sourcing Specialist
 




  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hybrid)
 



  





**Shift Hours:** 
 5:30 PM \- 2:30 AM IST
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities** 




  





**What will you do?** 




 As a Sourcing Specialist you will be responsible for proactively seeking to identify entry to senior level talent, primarily through effective and diligent Internet, database, and social media searches.
 


* You will quickly analyse social data and resumes to engage qualified candidates.
* You will be responsible for market and talent research ascertaining likely sourcing opportunities for well\- matched candidates and complete detailed Master Sourcing Plans.
* If a short listing assignment is undertaken you will conduct first level interviews to determine if there is a match to the client's needs.
* A tenacious knack to quickly execute research techniques and a determination to uncover hidden online information is essential for success. The ability to work in a fast paced, changing environment, where you will manage your daily activity to identify leads and engage people online and over the phone is vital.
* This exciting opportunity allows you to partner with multi\-location and/or global colleagues and assemble and execute appropriate sourcing methods to produce quality candidates for our clients.



**Vacancy Intake:** 




 Organize/join intake with the hiring manager/recruiter in order to get a complete picture of hard and soft requirements, culture and working environment.
 



 Identify screening criteria together with the client/recruiter.
 



 Upon completion of the intake meeting, create a master sourcing plan with appropriate sourcing strategy.
 



  





**Identification:** 




 Analyse job description and translate to search queries, to be used in database mining in various channels such as internal candidate database, job board databases, internet searches (Google and other web searches, LinkedIn and other social networks), and in some cases phone sourcing etc. as requested.
 



 Review CV’s for pattern recognition to guide search queries.
 



 Determine eligibility of candidates based on paper CV.
 



 Diligent internet research to find hidden information (passive candidates).
 



 Putting together a Master Sourcing Plan where applicable.
 



  





**Engagement, Screening and Submission:** 




 Make first and further connections with candidates.
 



 Engage and communicate with prospective candidates.
 



 Carry out remote interviews.
 



 Verbal review of qualifications.
 



 Determine fit of the candidate with the client’s organization.
 



 Create Candidate Profiling Form.
 



 Submit and position candidates on employment opportunities.
 



  





**Reporting:** 




 Daily/Weekly reporting of search and screening activity into the Delivery Manager and client.
 



 Make real\-time updates for timely and accurate record keeping of candidate activity and productivity.
 



  





**Relationship management :** 




 Act as clients / client facing recruiters ‘single point of contact’ (SPOC) from a daily delivery/operational perspective.
 



  





**What will you bring?** 



* 4\+ years in recruitment
* Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Experience in Non\-IT Recruitment is preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation and customer service skills.
* Should have excellent written communication skills.
* Knowledge of social media and social networking sites.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisition assignments across 1 or more industry sectors
* Demonstrated evidence of solid time management and organizational skills
* Demonstrated ability to self\-motivate, set goals and meet deadlines
* Customer service focus and ability to maintain courteous and professional working relationships



  





**What's in it for you?** 




 ● Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition
 



 ● Join a diverse and inclusive workplace
 



 ● Join a company with a wide range of learning, development and advancement opportunities
 



 ● Join a company that offers a great work/life balance
 



 ● Join a company with proven processes and high\-output technology to create efficiency

 Randstad is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome people from all walks of life \- race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected group status.
 



 At Randstad, we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just let us know.

**Insurity’s Next** 
**Product Marketing Manager**
 We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to play a pivotal role in how Insurity brings its strategy to market and accelerates growth. In this role, you’ll shape compelling market\-facing narratives, sharpen the commercial story behind our solutions, and create the messaging, proof points, and customer\-facing assets that help Sales engage buyers more effectively and move opportunities forward. This is a highly visible opportunity to influence launches, strengthen go\-to\-market execution, and help define how Insurity shows up in the market. This role is ideal for a strategic, hands\-on product marketer who can turn complex products into compelling market stories and partner cross\-functionally to drive growth.
   

  

**What Our Product Marketing Manager** 
**Will Do**
* Own ooordinated product launch and go\-to\-market strategy and execution for Insurity’s solutions and target market segments, grounded in a strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and product value.
* Develop clear, compelling positioning, messaging, value narratives, proof points, and competitive differentiation that help customers understand why Insurity’s solutions matter.
* Lead development of proof points, value narratives, competitive framing, and sales stories for priority solutions
* Use market, customer, and field insight to shape go\-to\-market priorities
* Create high\-impact product marketing assets, including product overviews, sales decks, website copy, battlecards, case studies, launch materials, and other field\-facing content that supports pipeline and revenue growth.
* Partner closely with Sales, Product, Demand Generation, Brand, and other cross\-functional teams to support launches, campaigns, strategic deals, and broader commercialization efforts.

* Contribute to product launches and growth programs by helping define launch strategy, shaping launch messaging and content, and ensuring the field has the materials needed to bring new products and features to market effectively.
* Perform market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight gathering to inform positioning, differentiation, and ongoing product marketing strategy.
* Educate and coach Sales and other customer\-facing teams on product value propositions, differentiation, and how to communicate Insurity’s value more effectively in the market.
* Independently lead key product marketing programs and create new assets, frameworks, or repeatable approaches needed to support evolving market and sales motions.
* Identify opportunities to improve go\-to\-market processes, launch readiness, and product marketing effectiveness, and help implement better ways of working across the team.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* 5–7 years of product marketing or related B2B technology marketing experience, in enterprise software, SaaS, insurtech, or a similarly complex solutions environment.
* Experience building positioning, messaging, proof points, sales collateral, launch assets, and customer\-facing content that supports revenue growth, field enablement, and stronger commercial execution.
* Experience owning software product launches, sales enablement, and go\-to\-market strategy preferred
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with analytical thinking, critical thinking, and the ability to translate complex products into clear, compelling customer value.

title: Finance & Accounting Lead - India GBS Back Office
description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry\-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
   

  

**Group Summary**
 Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial\-minded team. With 65\+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Finance \& Accounting Lead for India to take ownership of core accounting, controlling, and local finance governance activities as part of a shared services team. The role combines hands\-on controllership, local compliance knowledge, stakeholder management, and transition leadership.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as the key finance partner for India operations and the Global Business Service transformation team. This includes ensuring reliable month\-end close, statutory and audit readiness, process documentation, system alignment, and clear governance across Finance, HR, Tax, Payroll, Concur, OneStream, and SAP and SAP S/4HANA Cloud interfaces.
   

  

 This position requires a pragmatic finance leader who can stabilize current activities, lead a local team, support transformation decisions, and build scalable accounting processes in a cross\-border environment.
   

  

***Main Duties***
* Finance leadership \& continuity: Lead the India finance / accounting team and secure operational continuity during the replacement and transition phase.
* Accounting \& closing: Own or coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities, including reconciliations, accruals, provisions, cost center review, intercompany accounting, and management reporting inputs.
* Local statutory \& compliance: Ensure alignment with Indian statutory accounting, Companies Act requirements, GST / TDS related accounting, audit expectations, internal controls, and corporate finance policies.
* Controllership: Provide finance controllership for the India Back Office, including cost tracking, budget / forecast support, variance analysis, capitalization or project accounting topics where applicable, and escalation of financial risks.
* Global Business Service transition support: Support the movement of finance back\-office activities under the Global Business Service model, including role clarity, process mapping, RASIC / ownership definition, SLA / KPI setup, reporting cadence, and handover documentation.
* Systems \& process readiness: Partner with Finance, IT, HR, and external advisors on SAP S/4HANA Cloud, OneStream account structures, Workday / payroll interfaces, Concur processes, and related local requirements.
* Process harmonization: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate finance and accounting processes while respecting local statutory and tax requirements.
* Audit \& risk management: Coordinate internal and external audit requirements, ensure evidence readiness, monitor open findings, and drive remediation actions.
* Stakeholder management: Act as the key liaison between India local leadership, Corporate Finance, Business Services, Tax, HR, IT, project teams, and external consultants.
* Team development: Coach and develop the local finance / accounting team, clarify responsibilities, build backup structures, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.


***Governance \& Performance Management***
* Define and maintain clear accounting ownership across local India finance, Corporate Finance, and Global Business Service.
* Establish practical KPI / SLA tracking for service delivery, closing timelines, open items, reconciliations, audit requests, and issue resolution.
* Create transparent escalation paths and regular reporting for critical finance, tax, payroll, and system readiness topics.


***Education***
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), Cost Accountant (CMA), CPA, ACCA, or comparable professional qualification strongly preferred.
* Additional training in Indian tax / statutory compliance, internal controls, finance transformation, Lean Six Sigma, or project management is an advantage.


***Work Experience***
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in accounting, controllership, finance operations, or shared services / GBS environments.
* 3\+ years in a finance leadership, controller, accounting lead, or team lead role in India.
* Strong experience with India statutory accounting, audit coordination, tax\-sensitive accounting topics, and internal control requirements.
* Experience in automotive, engineering, IT services, shared service centers, or multinational matrix organizations is preferred.
* Practical experience with month\-end closing, intercompany processes, balance sheet reconciliations, cost center accounting, and management reporting.
* Experience with process transitions, system implementations, or finance transformation projects is a strong advantage.


**Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Indian accounting, statutory reporting, GST / TDS accounting implications, audit practices, and local control requirements.
* Solid understanding of IFRS / US\-GAAP or multinational corporate reporting requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC; SAP S/4HANA Cloud experience is preferred.
* Experience with OneStream, Concur, Workday Payroll / HR interfaces, Power BI, workflow tools, or finance automation is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail, and ability to translate financial data into clear management insights.
* Proven leadership, coaching, and team coordination skills in a multicultural environment.
* Structured working style with a strong sense of ownership, documentation discipline, and follow\-through.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, stabilize operations, and drive pragmatic solutions during transformation phases.
* Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken; ability to communicate with senior stakeholders and operational teams.


***Work Environment***
* High\-visibility finance leadership role within the India GBS Back Office / Finance transformation context.
* Regular collaboration with international stakeholders.
* Moderate travel may be required during setup, knowledge transfer, audit, or system alignment phases.
* The role requires a combination of hands\-on accounting execution, leadership, and transformation mindset.


**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
   

  

**AI\-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
   

  

**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision\-making.**
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.

description:
Step into the role of Personal Banker at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
   

  

 You will be responsible for delivering personalised, compliant, and high\-quality customer service across multiple digital and in\-person channels while supporting efficient banking operations.
   

  

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
   

  

  

* Resolve customer queries and issues efficiently while delivering a personalised experience across multiple communication channels.
* Provide exceptional customer service by handling inquiries, resolving issues, and supporting client requests accurately and on time.
* Collaborate with internal teams (sales, operations, risk, compliance) to meet customer needs and ensure smooth transaction execution.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management standards in all customer interactions.
* This is a voice role and minimum qualification required is graduate.


**Desirable Skills Set**
* Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to handle sensitive or complex information.
* Knowledge of banking operations, compliance, and risk management processes.
* International contact centre and voice experience preferred.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration across multiple digital channels to personalise each interaction with a customer.
* Enhancing the bank's digital capabilities when current technology is identified as not yet ready to support.
* Provision of exceptional customer service to clients by responding to inquiries, resolving issues and handling client requests efficiently.
* Support the collaboration of internal stakeholders including sales, operational, and risk management teams to meet client needs and expectations, so that transactions are executed accurately and on time.
* Support teams within the business operations function as needed, including risk management, compliance and collections.
* Comply with all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to customer care.
* To provide resolutions for customer queries/issues and personalise each interaction through the use of multiple communication channels.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and support
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub\-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**React Lead Developer** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Experience: 13 \-20 Years** 




  





 Apply here: React Developer – Fill out form
 



 Share you profile to Sabrish.a@capco.com
 



  





 As a React Developer, you’ll build and maintain the user\-facing components of web applications, delivering interactive, accessible, and visually engaging experiences. You’ll adhere to agreed frontend architecture and system design, partnering closely with the Lead React Developer to ensure reliable performance across devices and browsers, while meeting high standards for usability, accessibility, and maintainability.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





 \- Build and maintain React user interfaces using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, following established patterns and team standards.
 



 \- Implement assigned parts of key user journeys, focusing on correctness, performance basics, accessibility, and clean, readable code.
 



 \- Use and contribute to existing component libraries by adding small enhancements, fixing bugs, and following design system guidelines.
 



 \- Debug and resolve straightforward issues in existing codebases (UI defects, layout problems, minor functional bugs) with support from senior engineers.
 



 \- Ensure responsive behaviour across common screen sizes and verify changes in agreed target browsers/devices.
 



 \- Apply accessibility fundamentals (semantic HTML, labels, focus states, keyboard navigation) and use ARIA only when needed and guided by standards.
 



 \- Collaborate with product, UX/UI, backend engineers, and QA to clarify requirements, raise risks early, and deliver features end\-to\-end.
 



 \- Write and maintain unit/component tests for new work, and follow CI/CD pipelines (fixing build failures, addressing linting/type errors).
 



 \- Participate in code reviews by responding to feedback, learning team conventions, and gradually contributing constructive review comments.
 



 \- Document changes (README updates, component usage notes) and contribute to team ways of working through continuous improvement suggestions.
 



**Skills \& Experience** 



* 8 to 10 yrs of hands\-on experience building web applications or features using React and modern frontend tooling
* Good working knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+) and basic familiarity with TypeScript (able to read and write typed components with guidance).
* Solid fundamentals in HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive layouts and common modern CSS patterns (Flexbox/Grid), plus basic understanding of browser APIs.
* Ability to debug and improve existing code with support (fixing UI/layout issues, addressing simple defects, making small functional enhancements).
* Understanding of core frontend concepts such as component structure, props/state, and introductory state management patterns (Context, basic Redux usage is a plus).
* Awareness of performance basics (avoiding unnecessary re\-renders, sensible component composition) and willingness to learn deeper optimisation techniques.
* Familiarity with accessibility fundamentals and inclusive UI practices (semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, basic ARIA; exposure to WCAG is a plus).
* Exposure to testing and code quality practices (for example: Jest/React Testing Library basics; willingness to learn integration/e2e testing).
* Clear communication skills, openness to feedback, and ability to collaborate with designers, engineers, and product partners in a team environment.

Our vision and mission is to create innovative, transformative and contemporary technology solutions to empower our leaders and employees so they can focus on what matters most, our customers. We are technologists with strong business acumen focused on developing our talent to continually transform and innovate.  

We are seeking a **Data Engineer** with strong experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines. The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to ensure high\-quality, reliable, and performant software delivery across web platforms. **Key Relationships:**
Internal Stake Holder – EMEA ART Leader, ART Leadership team, India EMEA Technology AVP, and Business process Owners for EMEA Technology. **Key Responsibilities:*** As a Data Engineer, you’ll help build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that power analytics, reporting, and data products. * Assist in building and maintaining batch and/or streaming ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Develop and support data ingestion from internal systems and external sources (APIs, files, databases including structure, semi\-structured or unstructured data).
* Develop notebook to transform curated data into SCV specific unified data model
* Help model and curate datasets for analytics (dimensional models, curated “gold” tables, semantic layer inputs).
* Support data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting (validation rules, reconciliation).
* Collaborate with analysts, product owners, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver datasets.
* Contribute to documentation, data dictionaries, and runbooks.
* Participate in code reviews and follow engineering standards (naming, testing, CI/CD).
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and support incident resolution with guidance from senior engineers.
* Follow data governance and security policies (PII handling, access control, retention).

 **Education:*** Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent.

 **Technical Stack:*** SQL (DDL, DML, joins, aggregations, stored procedure, window functions basics)
* Programming (Python preferred; Java/Scala acceptable)
* Data concepts (schemas, structured/unstructured data, basic modelling)
* Understanding of software fundamentals: version control (Git), debugging, testing basics.
* Exposure to Azure cloud platform, especially:
* Data storage (Data Lake, blob/object storage)
* Compute (Spark/Databricks/Synapse)
* Event hub/Azure Stream Analytics
* Familiarity with orchestration tools (Synapse and ADF pipeline)
* Understanding of data modelling (star schema, slowly changing dimensions).
* Knowledge of DevOps basics: CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform).
* Any internship/project experience building pipelines or dashboards.

 **Soft Skills:*** Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance technical innovation with business value delivery.
* Business acumen: A level\-headed, clear communicator to gain detailed level of understanding of organizational business requirements and business dynamics.
* Self\-Motivated and able to work independently.
* Attention to detail
* Collaborative
* Team Player
* Decisive
* Supportive
* Passionate
* Professional
* Accountable

  

  

**About MetLife**  

Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East.  

As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value.  

Our purpose is simple \- to help our colleagues, customers, communities, and the world at large create a more confident future. United by purpose and guided by our core values \- Win Together, Do the Right Thing, Deliver Impact Over Activity, and Think Ahead \- we’re inspired to transform the next century in financial services. This position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. The candidate is a self\-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. The candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to U.S. Bank standards to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. The candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and DevOps principles.  

  

Essential Responsibilities:  


	+ Responsible for designing, developing, testing, operating and maintaining products.

	+ Exhibits relentless focus in software reliability engineering standards embedded into development standards.

	+ Reviews tasks critically and ensures they are appropriately prioritized and sized for incremental delivery. Anticipates and communicates blockers and delays before they require escalation.

* Five plus years’ experience with Pega Infinity 8\.x greater and supporting frameworks (CPM; Collections)

* Demonstrated experience in developing and integrating complex software solutions in the financial services industry, credit card and collections system experience a plus
 **Secondary Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Pega Customer Decision Hub experience.
* Exposure to event\-driven architecture (Kafka, streaming integrations)
* Experience in cloud\-native deployments (AWS/Azure/PegaCloud) and modernization initiatives
* Experience in DevOps CI/CD pipeline and integration with Pega Deployment Mgr, containerized deployments and Ansible scripting.

description:
**Description**
 Are you interested in building high\-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation leveraging the scalability and innovation with Amazon's AWS cloud services? Do you have a passion for ensuring a positive customer experience? This is the job for you.
   

  

 Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.
   

  

 At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM\+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.
   

  

 Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results\-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission\-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.
   

  

 Design Foundational Greenfield Services: You will collaborate with your team to architect and implement the core services that will form the backbone of this new accounting software. Your technical expertise and innovative thinking will be instrumental in ensuring the foundational services are designed with scalability, reliability, and performance in mind for Amazon.
   

  

 Adopting Latest Technology: You will have the chance to work with the latest technologies, frameworks, and tools to build these foundational services. This includes leveraging advancements in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data processing, and real\-time analytics.
   

  

 Solving High\-Scale Processing Challenges: This project will involve handling millions of transactions per day, presenting you with the unique challenge of designing and implementing robust, high\-performance solutions that can handle this scale of volume efficiently. You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real\-time analytics.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.
   

  

 Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices and using data to define and improve operational best practices.
   

  

 Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
   

  

 Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
   

  

 Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM\+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**Role Overview**  

We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data \& Analytics team.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end\-to\-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.


The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business\-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.

**Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected**

**About Role**

**1\. End\-to\-End BI Solution Development**

* Design, develop, and implement full\-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user\-facing reports and apps.
* Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well\-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
* Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.

**2\. Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL**

* Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).
* Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.
* Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
* Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.

**3\. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization**

* Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).
* Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.
* Develop high\-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.
* Implement navigation, drill\-through, parameterized views, and security (row\-level and object\-level) as required.
* Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

**4\. Data Analysis and Insights**

* Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.
* Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.

**5\. Data Governance, Documentation, and Support**

* Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.
* Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.
* Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.
* Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**6\. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.
* Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.
* Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.
* Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full\-stack ownership and reduced hand\-offs.

**About You**

* Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:
* *Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2\)*
* *Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse*
* *Power BI datasets, reports, and apps*
* Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.
* Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.
* Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.
* Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

**Analytical and Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment.
* Comfortable working in regulated or compliance\-driven environments.

**Education/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor/Master in relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience (typically 3\+ years) in a BI, analytics, or data engineering role delivering end\-to\-end BI solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working across the full BI stack, from data ingestion and modelling to reporting and user adoption.

The ideal candidate will orchestrate predictable, enterprise\-grade releases across integrated Salesforce and Zuora ecosystems while relentlessly removing systemic blockers.
   

  

**Agile Leadership \& Coaching**
* Facilitate Core Ceremonies: Lead high\-value Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives with an emphasis on continuous improvement.
* Agile Maturity \& Governance: Coach product teams, engineering leads, and business stakeholders on Agile/Scrum best practices, metrics, and empirical process control.

**Backlog, Scope \& Stakeholder Management**

* Scope Creep Control: Protect the team’s sprint commitments while managing changing business priorities typical in CRM and billing transformations.


**Impediment Removal \& Risk Management**
* Technical \& Process Blockers: Proactively identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks across teams (e.g., third\-party API rate limits, schema mismatches between Salesforce and Zuora, or stalled UAT sign\-offs).

**Job Responsibilities**
**HR Vendor Assessment Analyst (Fixed Term – 6 Months)**
 The second title clearly signals that the primary purpose is evaluating the HR vendor landscape and making recommendations.
   

  

 Add This to the "About the Role" Section
   

  

 In addition to supporting vendor operations and performance management, this role will lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's HR vendor ecosystem. The analyst will evaluate vendor capabilities, service delivery, contractual value, utilization, costs, risks, and business outcomes across multiple HR service areas. The individual will develop recommendations regarding vendor optimization, consolidation, expansion, or elimination to improve operational effectiveness, employee experience, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Add a New Responsibility Section
   

  

 HR Vendor Assessment \& Optimization
   

  

* Conduct a comprehensive review of all HR and People Services vendors across the employee lifecycle.
* Assess vendor performance, service quality, utilization, cost effectiveness, scalability, and strategic value.
* Evaluate vendor capabilities against current and future business requirements.
* Partner with HR, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback.
* Benchmark vendor offerings, service models, and capabilities against industry practices.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation, rationalization, renegotiation, or replacement.
* Develop business cases supporting recommendations to retain, expand, reduce, or eliminate vendor partnerships.
* Analyze vendor spend, contract terms, utilization rates, performance metrics, and return on investment.
* Create executive\-ready presentations and recommendations for senior leadership decision\-making.
* Support development of a future\-state HR vendor strategy and roadmap.

* Complete a comprehensive assessment of the HR vendor portfolio within the first six months.
* Deliver executive recommendations for vendor retention, consolidation, optimization, or elimination.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, operational efficiencies, and enhanced service quality.
* Establish a vendor scorecard framework to support ongoing governance and performance monitoring.
* Support development of a multi\-year HR vendor strategy aligned with business objectives.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience conducting vendor assessments, RFPs, vendor selections, or supplier rationalization initiatives.
* Background in HR Operations, Shared Services, Procurement, Consulting, or Business Transformation.

* Experience performing cost\-benefit analysis and vendor ROI assessments.

description:
**Job Purpose/ Summary** 




  





 The Legal Counsel will play a key role in supporting Maersk’s Global Customer Contracting Agenda by driving well\-governed, risk\-aware, and commercially strategic contract management processes. This role involves independently reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing complex maritime \-logistics, and commercial agreements, including those with key clients, while partnering closely with commercial account owners, product teams, and other key stakeholders. The position demands a comprehensive, business\-aligned approach to contract management—balancing customer expectations with legal protection and commercial priorities. The successful candidate will influence contract strategy, support stakeholder alignment, and contribute to continuous improvement in a dynamic, international environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Draft, review, and finalize complex maritime, logistics, and commercial agreements, including contracts with Key Clients.
* Lead contract negotiations with customers and external stakeholders, focusing on high\-value and complex agreements to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Own the legal contracting process for a region, partnering closely with relevant business stakeholders
* Lead stakeholder alignment calls and provides strategic input on contract design, playbooks, fallback positions, and negotiation strategy.
* Ensure compliance with legal policies and alignment with the organization’s strategic objectives, while mitigating legal risk exposure.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to obtain balanced outcomes that align legal protections with commercial priorities.
* Provide legal guidance on contractual risks and support the development of risk management strategies that align with business goals.
* Support the team manager in quality oversight, and supervision of new joiners.
* Mentor and act as a role model for junior team members to promote learning, consistent quality delivery and personal growth.
* Contribute expertise to legal department knowledge management initiatives, including the development of templates and best practice guidance.
* Stay abreast of legal, commercial, and industry trends, and support Legal’s strategic alignment with business developments.



  





**Required Experience \& Skills** 



* Educational degree in Law, i.e., a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, with substantial experience in contract review, drafting and negotiations. Advanced skills in working in a fast\-paced, international environment requiring strong analytical, communication and negotiation skills. Further, you:
* Have 8\+ years of experience in contract review, preferably in an international law firm or corporation.
* Possess strong contract negotiation skills and the ability to lead negotiations and handle complex agreements independently.
* Have strong working knowledge of international maritime and logistics law (preferred).
* Are highly proficient in MS Office and can manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* Are fluent in English (written and spoken); knowledge of an additional foreign language is a plus.



  





**Personal Characteristics** 




  





 You must have a resilient, can\-do attitude and the ability to navigate a complex and fast\-paced environment while demonstrating the following key qualities:
 


* Analytical \& Inquisitive: Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in contract reviews. Ability and willingness to question assumptions, conduct critical analysis, and spar with leaders or colleagues when necessary.
* Proactive \& Autonomous: Capable of working independently, taking ownership of key responsibilities, and meeting tight deadlines.
* Assertive \& Decisive: Confident in making informed decisions while balancing commercial and legal considerations.
* Strong Communication \& Negotiation Skills: Able to clearly and concisely communicate complex issues and topics in both oral and written form. Skilled in negotiating effectively while maintaining a compliance\-driven approach.
* Collaborative \& Adaptable: Comfortable working with cross\-border teams, engaging with stakeholders at all levels, and cooperating with business functions while upholding legal and compliance standards.
* Fostering a high Impact culture of best practices.

description:
Inventory Manager – Designer Sarees \& Bridal Wear

**Department:** Inventory \& Operations  
**Reports To:** Operations Manager / Business Head  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Head Office / Store / Warehouse / Franchise Locations  
**Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years in retail inventory management, preferably in fashion, ethnic wear, bridal wear or luxury retail

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised, detail\-oriented and experienced **Inventory Manager** to manage inventory operations across our designer retail stores specialising in **sarees, bridal outfits, designer lehengas, ethnic wear and occasion wear**.

The Inventory Manager will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, monitoring stock movement, managing inventory ageing, coordinating replenishment and transfers, conducting physical audits, and ensuring that high\-value designer and bridal inventory is properly tracked and controlled.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of retail inventory processes, excellent analytical skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with **store teams, warehouse teams, sales teams, designers, production/tailoring teams and accounts**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Inventory Management

* Manage end\-to\-end inventory for sarees, lehengas, bridal outfits, gowns, suits, accessories and other designer products.
* Maintain accurate records of all inward, outward, transfer, return and adjustment transactions.
* Monitor inventory by **design, collection, category, colour, size, fabric, price and SKU/style code**.
* Ensure every product is properly tagged, coded and recorded in the ERP system.
* Monitor high\-value and premium inventory with appropriate controls.
* Track samples, display pieces, alteration pieces and customer\-reserved merchandise separately.

2\. Stock Inward \& Outward

* Verify incoming stock against purchase orders, invoices, delivery challans and product details.
* Coordinate with designers, production teams and vendors for accurate stock receipts.
* Ensure proper documentation of stock issued to customers, sales teams, designers, alteration/tailoring teams and other departments.
* Monitor dispatches for bridal and customised orders.
* Ensure timely updating of all stock movements in the ERP.

3\. Stock Audits \& Inventory Accuracy

* Conduct regular physical stock audits and cycle counts across stores and warehouses.
* Reconcile physical stock with ERP records and identify discrepancies.
* Investigate shortages, excess stock, misplaced merchandise and system errors.
* Maintain proper documentation of inventory discrepancies and corrective actions.
* Ensure 100% inventory accuracy for high\-value bridal and designer merchandise.

4\. Inventory Ageing \& Stock Optimisation

* Prepare and analyse **inventory ageing reports**.
* Identify slow\-moving, non\-moving and dead stock.
* Track products that have remained unsold beyond defined ageing periods.
* Coordinate with the sales and management teams for suitable action on ageing inventory.
* Monitor seasonal collections and ensure timely stock rotation.
* Provide recommendations for transfers, promotions, markdowns or other stock optimisation measures.

5\. Replenishment \& Stock Transfers

* Monitor stock availability across all stores.
* Identify replenishment requirements based on sales trends and store requirements.
* Coordinate inter\-store stock transfers.
* Ensure proper documentation and ERP updating for all transfers.
* Track stock in transit and ensure timely receipt confirmation.
* Maintain optimum stock levels without unnecessary overstocking.

6\. Bridal \& Customer Order Inventory

* Maintain accurate inventory records for **bridal bookings, customer reservations and advance orders**.
* Ensure reserved merchandise is clearly identified and not accidentally sold.
* Track garments sent for alterations, customisation, embroidery, finishing or tailoring.
* Coordinate with sales and tailoring/design teams to ensure timely movement and return of customer garments.
* Maintain proper records for customised and made\-to\-order outfits.

7\. ERP \& Reporting

* Ensure all inventory transactions are accurately updated in **Logic ERP or equivalent retail ERP software**.
* Generate daily, weekly and monthly inventory reports.
* Prepare reports on:
* Stock availability
* Stock movement
* Inventory ageing
* Dead stock
* Slow\-moving stock
* Stock discrepancies
* Store transfers
* Replenishment requirements
* Stock in transit
* Customer reservations
* High\-value inventory
* Present inventory insights and recommendations to management.

8\. Coordination with Accounts

* Coordinate with the Accounts team for inventory reconciliation.
* Assist in reconciliation between ERP records, invoices and accounting records in **Tally**.
* Verify purchase and sales\-related inventory documentation.
* Support month\-end and year\-end stock reconciliation.
* Ensure proper documentation for stock adjustments, returns and write\-offs.

9\. Store Operations \& SOP Compliance

* Ensure all stores follow standard inventory handling and storage procedures.
* Implement and monitor inventory SOPs across company\-owned and franchise stores.
* Train store staff on stock handling, tagging, billing\-related inventory processes and stock documentation.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of premium sarees, bridal outfits and delicate designer garments.
* Conduct periodic operational and inventory audits at stores and franchise locations.

10\. Coordination with Designers \& Production Teams

* Coordinate with designers and production teams regarding new collections and stock availability.
* Track movement of garments between design, production, warehouse and retail stores.
* Maintain accurate records of unfinished, completed, altered and customised garments.
* Monitor stock received from designers and ensure correct SKU/style coding.
* Coordinate with designers and sales teams for product identification and inventory queries.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, Retail Management** or a related field.
* Minimum **3–5 years of experience in inventory management**, preferably in fashion, ethnic wear, bridal wear, designer retail or luxury retail.
* Hands\-on experience with **Logic ERP or similar ERP software** is preferred/mandatory.
* Good working knowledge of **Tally and inventory reconciliation**.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Excellent organisational and communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Ability to manage high\-value and sensitive inventory.
* Willingness to travel between stores, warehouse and franchise locations when required.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Designer sarees and ethnic wear
* Bridal lehengas and wedding outfits
* Luxury fashion retail
* Multi\-store retail inventory
* Boutique or designer studio operations
* Garment/fashion inventory management
* Handling high\-value merchandise
* Working with designers and production/tailoring teams
* Franchise inventory management

Key Skills

* Retail Inventory Management
* Stock Auditing \& Reconciliation
* Inventory Ageing Analysis
* Dead Stock Management
* Stock Forecasting \& Replenishment
* ERP Management
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* Tally
* Inter\-store Stock Transfers
* Retail Operations
* SOP Implementation
* Data Analysis \& Reporting
* Team Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Inventory Manager will be evaluated on:

* Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock discrepancies
* Timeliness of stock updates in ERP
* Reduction in dead and ageing inventory
* Stock availability and replenishment efficiency
* Accuracy of physical stock audits
* Timely completion of stock reconciliation
* Reduction in stock loss/misplacement
* Accuracy of store\-to\-store transfers
* Compliance with inventory SOPs
* Timely and accurate management reporting

Travel Requirement

The candidate must be flexible to travel between **company\-owned stores, franchise stores, warehouses and other business locations** as required for:

* Inventory audits
* Physical stock verification
* Store operational reviews
* Stock reconciliation
* Inter\-store transfers
* SOP implementation
* Inventory training and process improvement

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is **highly organised, commercially aware, analytical and hands\-on**, with the ability to manage both numbers and people. They should understand that designer and bridal inventory requires a high level of control because products are often **high\-value, unique, seasonal, customised and sometimes one\-of\-a\-kind**.

The person should be comfortable working closely with **store managers, sales teams, designers, tailors, warehouse teams, accounts and senior management** to ensure that the right product is available at the right location at the right time, with complete inventory accuracy.

Pay: ₹55,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

****About The Role:****
 Directly sells enterprise security software solutions across the breadth of the company’s products and drives incremental revenue with new customers, primarily through flexible and scalable licensing models. Plans, designs, develops and tests software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud\-based or internet\-related tools.
